head: eabe64bd8ca9e1d9450b4819f11c9cb1fb859a0a
scope: Read-only code, saved reports and metadata audit; no patient array/model checkpoint reads, no training, no tracked edits

interfaces.name: Permitted observation DTO
interfaces.reuse: Six image channels with coverage and availability, affine, tool geometry and observed procedure state; inference_only forbids supplied_annotation nominal channels; unknown payload zeroed. Immutable arrays and metadata checks.
interfaces.limit: Provenance strings do not establish estimator ancestry or upstream independence. One structural-intensity channel does not represent independent MRI and CT series simultaneously.

interfaces.name: SpatialPolicy
interfaces.reuse: CNN actor and candidate-aware value baseline accept only exact SpatialObservation DTO. Physical ray geometry and missingness explicit. Parameter hash reusable.
interfaces.limit: No privileged critic, multimodal encoder or memory. One crop <=64 per axis; do not claim whole-tool visibility.

interfaces.name: Spatial loss and update
interfaces.reuse: SpatialTransition, imitation_loss, reinforce_loss and gradient_step with full-episode on-policy bookkeeping, single-use loss binding and gradient receipts.
interfaces.limit: Current context explicitly permits one synthetic source and two-step task only; no general patient/population training.

interfaces.name: NativeSpatialCase/Task
interfaces.reuse: Separate target scoring reference; source-only target-independent hash; nominal planning clone; complete-tool fixed or nominal/cavity proposals; frozen state and history; bounded source crop.
interfaces.limit: One deterministic world; source-axis-normal aperture; 1-6 macro-strokes; support shared by actor, legality, simulator and audit; function/graph reward disabled.

interfaces.name: Observed beam search
interfaces.reuse: Bounded observed nominal search; negative opening prefixes retained; optional frozen actor ordering yields hybrid comparator; lazy nominal transitions; model-call and wall accounting.
interfaces.limit: Search may access whole nominal field while actor only sees crop; needs matched evidence contract or explicit representation comparison.

interfaces.name: Exact tiny teacher and bounded runner
interfaces.reuse: Exact finite-tree nominal teacher, conflict detection, teacher trace validation, sealed source/declaration hashes, supervised worker budgets, separate offline/online/audit costs.
interfaces.limit: Hard-coded single six-cell development fixture; current teacher sees nominal model, not privileged anatomy.

interfaces.name: Independent native episode audit
interfaces.reuse: Independently recompute full-tool geometry, removed-cell union and target/normal physical accounting; require complete committed episode and bound reference hashes; reject planning clone as final evaluation.
interfaces.limit: Audit uses same observed_support; validates arithmetic/geometry implementation, not independent measured tissue truth or biomechanics.

interfaces.name: Patient role controls
interfaces.reuse: Pinned BTC metadata; TRAIN vs SELECT role admission before patient load; all derivatives grouped by BTC participant; patient-uniform BC and on-policy batch bookkeeping.
interfaces.limit: Only six TRAIN and two SELECT admitted; sealed transfer patients not made available by relabeling a caller manifest.

interfaces.name: Freeze/ledger evaluation
interfaces.reuse: Freeze candidates and models before evaluation, claimed partition ledger, final/stress restrictions, single-patient inference declaration.
interfaces.limit: World partition independence alone is not unseen-patient independence or patient-linked measured ground truth.

interfaces.name: Whole-source/local representation preparation
interfaces.reuse: Conservative coarse cell averages with coverage and source affine; explicit permitted-source contract.
interfaces.limit: Outside current policy; target-local centering must use permitted estimated target, never withheld labels. Current data only show representation coverage.

interfaces.name: Functional evaluation sealing
interfaces.reuse: Seal exact sequence/checkpoint before functional reveal; durable shared ledger and saved binding.
interfaces.limit: FunctionalEvidence currently permits population_prior_sensitivity only (functional_evidence.py:37-49,134-138); cannot be relabeled as withheld patient functional anatomy.

leakage_pathways.finding: Default patient adapter is annotation_assisted; nominal_target defaults to union of evaluator compartments at lines 890-892.
leakage_pathways.action: Require explicit inference_only plus validated scan-derived estimates in new limited-observation path. Keep annotation-assisted as a separate upper-bound experiment.

leakage_pathways.finding: observed_support defines native engine tissue, certified legal inventory and evaluator geometry. Current target-swap controls do not cover hidden support, vessels or mechanical truth.
leakage_pathways.action: Generate deployment candidates/masks/cavity from permitted nominal model only. Freeze geometry/action sequence before separate hidden replay. A hidden-world rejection is an evaluated failure, never a silently removed candidate.

leakage_pathways.finding: observed_cavity is exact simulated committed removal, not an observed operative cavity.
leakage_pathways.action: For MRI/CT-only preoperative deployment, feed nominal predicted state and action history; only add actual measured cavity in a separately declared online sensing condition.

leakage_pathways.finding: derived_from_scan is a checked label, not proof: estimator weights, support, normalization mask, crop center, registration, access and proposals can encode held-out labels.
leakage_pathways.action: Bind preprocessing/estimator training ancestry and source cutoff; vary every withheld channel while checking exact observation, inventory, mask, crop, action and logits invariance.

leakage_pathways.finding: Current search can see full permitted field while actor sees crop. Legacy native feature policy includes explicit per-action benefit/contact summaries.
leakage_pathways.action: Use common limited envelope, actions, horizon, nominal objective and calls/time budgets for primary comparison. Treat legacy feature/oracle and full-annotation inputs as separate ablations.

leakage_pathways.finding: SELECT/transfer/patient roles, checkpoint choice, proposed access/tool choices and hyperparameters can leak withheld outcomes even when tensors are clean.
leakage_pathways.action: Freeze patient groups, annotation cutoff, preprocessing, model, objective, actions and stopping rule before held-out references are opened; store reference reader outside planner process.

leakage_pathways.finding: Current functional fields are population priors and native task functional reward is disabled. No patient-linked withheld hazard outcome is represented by the present native spatial evaluator.
leakage_pathways.action: Add explicitly registered patient-linked reference channels with provenance/coverage, score geometric exposure only. Keep missing evidence null; do not infer neurological injury risk.

leakage_pathways.finding: GeneratedDevelopmentContext only accepts one generated source, two steps, zero real patients; legacy model admission rejects any model hash.
leakage_pathways.action: Implement a new versioned source-use/training context for authorized rich simulation and limited-observation experiments; preserve old narrow contracts and historical receipts.

verification.scope: Existing analytic DTO/invariance/evaluator controls; no training; no patient payload access
